scope: Fixed residual PPO iteration32, original TRAIN128; not changing-policy training or formal A/B.

opening_title: 残差PPO第32次更新｜固定策略实测
opening_lines: 同一固定策略：TRAIN19、23、107、0，结果分别保留。

closing_lines: 空中22、条件恢复14、完整0；不将四个回合拼成一个成功。
完整球拍、原球场和规则；首次落点与恢复分别显示。
正式达标仍需同一冻结策略完成A/B各200回合。
evaluation_footer: PPO iter32固定TRAIN128｜空中22、条件恢复14、完整0｜非正式A/B
caveats: Actual native50Hz body poses and exact contact events. No generated or interpolated motion.
Cases19,23,107,0 were fixed before this assessment. TRAIN19 was motivated by a training success; it is not a blind/random selection.
These are fixed-policy evaluation episodes, distinct from the earlier changing-policy TRAIN19_LANE275_EP1 success.
The terminal image uses the last valid50Hz sample, not an invented exact terminal pose.
The original formal A/B acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.
